classification_rule.bullish: at least 2 of target upside >=10%, buy rating, EPS 30d change >=5%
classification_rule.bearish: at least 2 of target upside <=-10%, sell rating, EPS 30d change <=-5%
classification_rule.base: otherwise, only when required data pass

scenario_rule: Analyst low/mean/high when valid; otherwise current close +/-2 ATR14 (or +/-10%) labelled non-consensus.
